The '''Illisurevimurasi sector''', also known as the '''I-Sector''', was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
The sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Bliss Shargael|Shargael]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="POT" />
